# Newootz Knives

> > Newootz Knives specializes in premium handmade folding and fixed-blade knives featuring Damascus steel, Japanese VG10, and advanced powder steels with exotic handle materials.

Newootz Knives offers a curated collection of everyday carry pocket knives, hunting knives, and chef knives crafted with premium steel alloys including Damascus, VG10, M390, and DC53. Each knife features carefully selected handle materials like titanium, G10, rosewood, and snakewood, serving both collectors and outdoor enthusiasts.

- VG10 Steel
- M390 Powder Steel
- DC53 Cold Work Steel

## Pocket Knives by Steel Type

- [Damascus Steel Pocket Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/damascus-steel-pocket-knives): Damascus Steel and VG10 Japanese pocket knives including Higonokami models
- [M390 Blades Pocket Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/pocket-knives-m390-blades): M390 powder steel pocket knives with titanium handles and high edge retention
- [VG10 Pocket Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/vg10-pocket-knives): VG10 steel everyday carry pocket knives with excellent edge retention
- [DC53 Pocket Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/dc53-pocket-knives): DC53 cold work steel pocket knives with snakewood and carbon fiber handles
- [D2 Pocket Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/d2-pocket-knives): D2 tool steel pocket knives with G10 handles and liner lock mechanism
- [14C28N Blades Pocket Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/14c28n-blades): 14C28N stainless steel pocket knives with G10 and titanium handles
- [CPM-SV35N Pocket Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/cpm-sv35n-pocket-knives): CPM-S35VN steel pocket knives with TC4 titanium alloy handles
- [Triple Steel Pocket Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/triple-steel-pocket-knives): Composite triplet steel EDC and survival folding knives with desert ironwood

## Hunting Knives by Steel Type

- [Damascus Hunting Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/damascus-hunting-knives): VG10 Damascus steel fixed-blade hunting knives with rosewood and ebony
- [M390 Hunting Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/m390-hunting-knives): M390 steel full-tang hunting knives with desert ironwood and ebony
- [DC53 Hunting Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/dc53-hunting-knives): DC53 tactical fixed-blade Bowie hunting knives with superior toughness
- [14C28N Hunting Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/14c28n-hunting-knife): 14C28N Sandvik steel fixed-blade hunting knives with rosewood handles
- [A2 Hunting Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/a2-hunting-knives): A2 tool steel full-tang hunting knives with yellow sandalwood handles

## Kitchen Knives

- [Chef Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/chef-knives): VG10 Damascus Japanese Gyuto chef knives with handmade blades
- [Chopping Knives](https://newootz.com/collections/chopping-knives): Damascus and DC53 Japanese kitchen chopping knives with G10 handles
